(async () => { window.__bdl = (() => { const app = window.app; const tick = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const frame = () => new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => r())); const leaf = (p) => app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown').find((l) => l.view.file && (l.view.file.path === p || l.view.file.name === p)); const file = (p) => app.vault.getFileByPath(p) || app.vault.getMarkdownFiles().find((f) => f.name === p); const cm = (p) => { const l = leaf(p); if (!l) throw new Error('no editor for ' + p); return l.view.editor.cm; }; const live = async (l) => { const s = l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({ ...s, state: { ...s.state, mode: 'source', source: false } }); }; const setup = async (src, tgt) => { app.workspace.detachLeavesOfType('markdown'); await tick(100); const a = app.workspace.getLeaf(true); await a.openFile(file(src)); await live(a); if (tgt) { const b = app.workspace.createLeafBySplit(a, 'vertical'); await b.openFile(file(tgt)); await live(b); } await tick(400); return 'ok'; }; const hover = async (p, line) => { const v = cm(p); const c = v.coordsAtPos(v.state.doc.line(line + 1).from); if (!c) throw new Error('line ' + line + ' is not drawn'); v.contentDOM.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', { bubbles: true, clientX: c.left + 8, clientY: (c.top + c.bottom) / 2 })); await frame(); await tick(60); const h = v.dom.querySelector('.bdl-handle'); return h && h.style.display !== 'none' ? h : null; }; let dt = null; let handle = null; const start = async (p, line) => { handle = await hover(p, line); if (!handle) throw new Error('no handle at ' + p + ' line ' + line); dt = new DataTransfer(); handle.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragstart', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer: dt })); return dt.types.join(','); }; const drop = async (p, line, ch, ctrl) => { const v = cm(p); const ln = v.state.doc.line(line + 1); const pos = Math.min(ln.from + ch, ln.to); const c = v.coordsAtPos(pos); const x = c.left + 1; const y = (c.top + c.bottom) / 2; const el = document.elementFromPoint(x, y) || v.contentDOM; for (const t of ['dragenter', 'dragover']) el.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent(t, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer: dt, clientX: x, clientY: y })); el.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('drop', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer: dt, clientX: x, clientY: y, ctrlKey: !!ctrl })); handle.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragend', { bubbles: true, dataTransfer: dt })); await tick(200); return 'ok'; }; const cancel = async () => { handle.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragend', { bubbles: true, dataTransfer: dt })); await tick(200); return dt.getData('text/plain'); }; const text = (p) => leaf(p) ? leaf(p).view.editor.getValue() : null; return { tick, leaf, file, cm, setup, hover, start, drop, cancel, text }; })(); document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); app.workspace.detachLeavesOfType('markdown'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); await app.vault.modify(window.__bdl.file('Research.md'), "Sleep before a test improves recall more than one extra hour of study.
